messages:
sec-bot: ALERT: Suspicious pod hostPath mount detected in namespace 'billing' (risk: HIGH). Pod: billing-worker-7c9f5, node: prod-gpu-12. Trigger: auditlog rule 'hostpath-write' matched.
sec-bot: Audit snippet: `user=system:serviceaccount:billing:billing-sa verb=create resource=pods`
maria: I'm looking. Which image and SA? Any vols besides hostPath?
ashwin: Pod spec snapshot from kube-apiserver (trimmed):
```yaml
metadata:
  name: billing-worker-7c9f5
  namespace: billing
spec:
  serviceAccountName: billing-sa
  containers:
  - name: worker
    image: registry.internal/redwood/billing-worker:sha256:abc123
    volumeMounts:
    - mountPath: /var/run/secrets/host
      name: host-sock
  volumes:
  - name: host-sock
    hostPath:
      path: /var/run
      type: Directory
  - name: proc
    hostPath:
      path: /proc
```
jordan: Confirmed hostPath to /proc and /var/run. That's a hard deny in our policy. When was this SA bound to elevated role?
kai: Checked RBAC: there is a ClusterRoleBinding 'billing-admin-binding' created 6h ago binding cluster-admin to ServiceAccount billing:billing-sa. Creator: infra-deployer@redwood.corp via ci-pipeline.
maria: That is concerning. Could be CI misconfig or token compromise. Node is prod-gpu-12; let's isolate. ops_lead: Agreed. Plan: cordon node, evict non-critical pods, pull logs, snapshot node, revoke SA tokens. Any objections?
ashwin: No objections. I'll cordon and taint, then evict. Commands: `kubectl cordon prod-gpu-12` and `kubectl drain prod-gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.
maria: I'll create a forensic snapshot: collect container runtime events, dmesg, /var/log/syslog, and Docker/CRI logs. Also saving kubelet journal: `journalctl -u kubelet -o short-iso > /tmp/kubelet.journal`
jordan: Who has access to the node console? I'll need to capture /proc mounts and running processes before eviction. Use `nsenter` if possible.
kai: I've disabled the ClusterRoleBinding and rotated the SA token (created new secret). Also disabled CI job that created binding. Noted: older tokens may still work until kube-apiserver cache or long-lived tokens—need to revoke via kube-controller?
maria: Add steps: 1) revoke SA tokens (patch serviceaccount to remove secrets), 2) delete old secrets, 3) rotate KMS keys for any secrets that were retrieved by billing-sa, 4) enable audit log exfil filters.
ashwin: Eviction started. Pod terminated, new pod didn't recreate (Deployment blocked by RBAC). Node cordoned.
ashwin: Collected container inspect: image sha matches internal build, but layer timestamps show a post-build modification at ~2:14 UTC — need to check registry mutability.
jordan: I'll pull the image from registry and run cosign verify. If signature missing or fails, mark image as tampered.
kai: Quick mitigation items: - Add gate in CI to block ClusterRoleBinding from deploy pipelines, - enforce image signature verification in admission controller (cosign), - block hostPath mounts via OPA Gatekeeper policy, - require KMS retrieval audit events.
maria: For communications: notify SOC, list of affected customers (billing namespace only), and Slack #incidents. Draft a short blurb for legal: we found privileged SA + hostPath mounts, contained, investigating.
ops_lead: Post-incident tasks assigned: 1) infra (kai) — CI RBAC guard, 2) runtime (ashwin) — node forensics & image verification, 3) sec (maria) — rotate KMS keys and audit logs retention change, 4) eng (jordan) — registry immutability/scan. ETA 48h for initial report.
maria: I'll open a taks in Jira: SEC-2371 with the timeline and artifacts attached. Also enabling persistent audit logs to S3 for 90 days.
kai: Noted. Will follow up with PR for Gatekeeper policy this morning.
sec-bot: NOTE: incident tagged 'hostpath-privilege-176825' and synthetic alert will follow-up with a summary at 1768258000.
